title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 13 March 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 12 March 2026 Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in Western, Sabaragamuwa and Northwestern provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts after 2.00 pm. A few showers may occur in Uva and Eastern provinces. Mainly fair weather will prevail elsewhere over the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle, Matara and Kurunegala districts during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
